def compute_power(base, exponent, modulus):
    result = 1
    while exponent > 0:
        if exponent & 1:
            result = (result * base) % modulus
        base = (base * base) % modulus
        exponent >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    P, K = map(int, input().split())

    MOD = 1000000007

    if K == 0:
        print(compute_power(P, P - 1, MOD))
        return
    if K == 1:
        print(compute_power(P, P, MOD))
        return

    visited = [False] * P
    cycle_size = 0
    current_value = 1
    while not visited[current_value]:
        visited[current_value] = True
        cycle_size += 1
        current_value = (K * current_value) % P

    print(compute_power(P, cycle_size, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
